mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 245 index level signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 245 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint RSAFS and HOUST growth signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM), reduced wage pressures expand corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the tight labor market regime (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and capacity utilization, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through near-term earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 102 index level signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 102 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts declining below 1,100 thousand units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower consumption expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicate strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
